Audit of two GGUF files: an abliterated community variant of Qwen3.8-27B and the official model, both around 4.8 bits per weight. Question: where do they differ, and is the difference the published abliteration edit? Everything here is a screening (quantized GGUF) result. text: Exploratory follow-up after scoring: each matrix against the noise floor of its own kind, the direction the structured matrices share, and its cosine with the refusal direction at every layer.

Five of eight predictions were refuted: the edit is not in every residual-writing matrix and the pooled top direction is a quantization artefact. Exploratory: 52 matrices in layers 22 to 51 share one direction (minimum cosine 0.997); its cosine with the official model's refusal direction peaks at layer 34 (0.87). This rests on an exploratory analysis and is a screening (quantized GGUF) result.
